name: Assign work to an agent
description: The execution loop of the task board: when a task is assigned to an AI agent, acknowledge by moving it to In progress, then either RUN the agent against the task and park the result at In review for a human — or, when the assignee is a manager on the org chart and the task is a root task labeled 'epic', DECOMPOSE it instead: the manager splits it into subtasks assigned to its direct reports (depth 1, enforced server-side), and the parent waits in In progress until the subtask-rollup workflow moves it to In review. On failure the task auto-rolls back to To do with an explanatory comment. Guardrail refusals (concurrency queue, budget pause, circuit breaker) skip the error comment — the guardrails already posted a more specific one. Tune or disable per org: this file is yours to edit, and the trigger can be deactivated in Automations. Agents bound to an external runtime (tale-daemon) dispatch instead of running inline: the task stays In progress until the daemon reports back (its completion moves the task to In review; failures roll back automatically).
